prose:
A Meta Muse Spark model page yielded a short, flattened benchmark table. Column and row relationships were not reliably preserved, so individual figures could not safely be assigned to tasks or compared across models.

A model version named in the listing does not establish availability, release terms or a verified performance gain. The thin extraction supports identifying the page, not reconstructing a leaderboard from detached numbers.
highlights: Scores cannot safely be mapped to tasks
